decision: Introduce a minimal mission envelope as the executable bridge object instead of assuming full ADR/Sprint/Mission orchestration is already live.
rationale: The runtime harness needs a concrete mission-shaped runtime object now; the full governance hierarchy can remain optional metadata.

decision: Model ADR and sprint references as optional governance metadata attached to the mission envelope.
rationale: Current runs need mission-only mode to work without breaking future compatibility.

decision: Compile the context packet from AGENTS.md, git branch/HEAD/status, dirty inventory, path policy, validation commands, and explicit handoff text.
rationale: These inputs are sufficient to stop agents from rediscovering baseline rules each run without introducing retrieval complexity.

decision: Emit a reproducible mission receipt before adding retrieval or higher-order orchestration.
rationale: Deterministic serialization and hashes establish trust and debugging value before any graph or memory layer is introduced.

decision: Keep ADR/Sprint/Mission orchestration documentary for now and avoid forcing the executable path to depend on it.
rationale: The executable stack already has enough control-plane pieces; a smaller bridge is safer and easier to stabilize.
